title: The State of School Purchasing Report
body_markdown:
**Key Takeaways:**


- This report surveyed 2,000+ education decision makers about the logistics of edtech purchasing.
- 62% of schools identify needs year-round, while 54% make purchasing decisions throughout the year.
- Building administrators (61%) and instructional staff (59%) now have the greatest influence on purchasing decisions.
- Professional development (68%) and instructional tools (63%) lead schools’ investment priorities for the next 12–24 months.
